title: worker wait
description: Block until the targeted workers finish - the dispatcher's wait step. Polls activity and returns when no targeted slot is actively working (idle/waiting/dead); exits nonzero at the timeout. CLI-only: a long blocking call does not belong on the agent MCP surface.

slots.description: slot subset spec like "a", "1,3", "a-c" (default: all slots)

timeout.description: max seconds to wait before giving up (default 1800)
